segments.text:
V. 28.
He ſaid, An Enemy hath done this —A plain Anſwer to the great Queſtion, concerning the Origin of Evil. GOD made Men (as he did Angels) Intelligent Creatures, and conſequently Free either to chuſe Good or Evil: But he implanted no Evil in the human Soul: An Enemy (with Man's Concurrence) hath done this.

Darnel, in the Church, is, properly, outſide Chriſtians, ſuch as have the Form of Godlineſs, without the Power. Open Sinners, ſuch as have neither the Form nor the Power, are not ſo properly Darnel, as Thiſtles and Brambles: Theſe ought to be rooted up without Delay, and not ſuffered in the Chriſtian Community. Whereas ſhould fallible Men attempt to gather up the darnel, they would often root up the wheat with them.
